data.title: 青山七海 · 晨曦榻榻米的安宁圆满依偎
data.description: 初升阳光洒满榻榻米床铺。马尾解开后的深茶长发披散在枕边，七海整个人依偎在你的怀里，小手抚摸着你的下巴，带着初尝圆满后的纯真甜笑，用关西腔轻声唤你早安。
data.location: sunlit morning tatami bedroom with warm morning glow
data.action: tangled in white futon sheets with bare shoulders exposed, stroking partner cheek gently with a radiant Kansai wife smile
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunbeams pouring across tatami and sheets
data.mood: morning newlywed bliss, perfect peace, unconditional romantic fulfillment
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets with bare shoulders and loose hair, Nanami Aoyama caresses partner cheek with a radiant loving wife smile in morning light.
data.animaCaption: Nanami Aoyama caressing partner cheek lovingly in morning futon.
